crossRefs.note: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children…
On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim,
The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud…
Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
“Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of…
On the eighth day Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur, prince of the children of Manasseh,
Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

people.name: Ammihud
people.line: Father of Elishama, leader of Ephraim

people.name: Elishama
people.line: A leader from the tribe of Ephraim.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Gamaliel
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the Exodus.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Pedahzur
people.line: Father of Gamaliel, leader from Manasseh

translations.web: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
translations.bsb: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, and from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
translations.kjv: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
